test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Managers who __delegate__ reduce their work load.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Retain**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'delegate'** is a verb in this context, meaning to entrust tasks or responsibilities to others (Hindi meaning: प्रतिनिधि मनोनीत करना). 

 
 
• For example, "The supervisor decided to **delegate** some tasks to the new intern."
 
 
 
• The correct antonym is **'retain'**, which in this context means to keep or continue to have something (Hindi meaning: बरकरार रखना).
 
 
• For example, "Despite the presence of capable staff, the boss chose to **retain** all the responsibilities herself."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Retain"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Appoint: **It refers to the act of assigning a job or position to someone (Hindi meaning: नियुक्त करना).
 
• **Nominate:** It means to formally suggest someone for a position, role, or duty (Hindi meaning: मनोनीत करना).
 
• **Depute:** This verb is another term for delegating duties or authority to someone else (Hindi meaning: प्रतिनिधि मनोनीत करना).

The correct answer is: **Learned**.
